description: Source code for the IMediaExtractor interface implementation, including BpMediaExtractor class, transaction handling, and media extractor registration and dumping functions within the Android media framework.

classes.name: BpMediaExtractor
classes.description: Proxy class implementing IMediaExtractor interface for IPC communication with media extractor service.

methods.name: countTracks
methods.description: Returns the number of media tracks.

methods.name: getTrack
methods.description: Retrieves a specific media track by index.

methods.name: getTrackMetaData
methods.description: Gets metadata for a specific track.

methods.name: flags
methods.description: Returns flags associated with the media extractor.

methods.name: setMediaCas
methods.description: Sets media Conditional Access System token.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the media extractor.

methods.name: setEntryPoint
methods.description: Sets the entry point for media processing.
